cittekaggatāsaṅkhātānī.g: ettha yadipi somanassadomanassasaṅkhātāni jhānaṅgāni natthi, sukhadukkhasaṅkhātāni pana somanassadomanassabhūtāneva jhānaṅgāni, na kāyikasukhadukkhabhūtānīti imassa dassanatthaṁ somanassadomanassaggahaṇaṁ kataṁ.

cittekaggatāsaṅkhātāni.g: ettha yadipi somanassadomanassasaṅkhātāni jhānaṅgāni natthi, sukhadukkhasaṅkhātāni pana somanassadomanassabhūtāneva jhānaṅgāni, na kāyikasukhadukkhabhūtānīti imassa dassanatthaṁ somanassadomanassaggahaṇaṁ kataṁ.

cittekaggatāyā.g: sukhādīhi, tadaññehi abhiniropanādīhi ca anindriyakiccatāya ca anupanijjhāyanakiccatāya ca asamānatāya pañcaviññāṇesu cittekaggatāya jhānaṅganti anuddhaṭabhāve kāraṇaṁ na vattabbanti.

cittekaggatāya.g: sukhādīhi, tadaññehi abhiniropanādīhi ca anindriyakiccatāya ca anupanijjhāyanakiccatāya ca asamānatāya pañcaviññāṇesu cittekaggatāya jhānaṅganti anuddhaṭabhāve kāraṇaṁ na vattabbanti.
